analyses.search_v3_recommendation: descriptively recommend stage/pitch/radius/polarity levels with the highest fraction of complete stable correspondence and lowest median root shift; do not call them validated or optimal
analyses.stage_relation: report empirical distributions and modal stable eligible-cusp/cell counts for every stage count without a target pass label
analyses.transition_representatives: retain complete three-map artifacts for the first canonical case of every distinct (stage_count, stable_eligible_cusp_count, stable_eligible_cell_count) transition, capped at 14 cases

cross_map_correspondence.algorithm: global minimum-cost rectangular Hungarian assignment in Euclidean (r,z)
cross_map_correspondence.decision_order: cluster each map, assign primary-to-refined and primary-to-enlarged in 2D, then compare classifications and eligibility
cross_map_correspondence.stable_root: matched in all three maps, same X/O classification and same cusp/cell eligibility, with both shifts within assignment distance

eligible_cell: clustered vector null is strictly inside the declared plasma channel
local classification is verified O with topological index +1
a nearby simple closed constant-psi component lies wholly inside the plasma channel
eligible_cusp: clustered vector null is strictly inside the declared plasma channel with the mesh margin
local classification is verified X with topological index -1
offset constant-psi probes establish cell-bounding separatrix connectivity
root is not in any excluded zone

failure_taxonomy.CROSS_MAP_UNMATCHED: a primary clustered root has no preregistered 2D correspondence
failure_taxonomy.FIELD_ENLARGED_INVALID: enlarged-domain map failed solver, artifact or field gates
failure_taxonomy.FIELD_PRIMARY_INVALID: primary map failed solver, artifact or field gates
failure_taxonomy.FIELD_REFINED_INVALID: refined map failed solver, artifact or field gates
failure_taxonomy.GEOMETRY_INVALID: strict accepted geometry could not be constructed
failure_taxonomy.GPU_FIELD_REPLAY_FAILURE: absolute field-map differences exceeded preregistered equality tolerances
failure_taxonomy.GPU_RESIDUAL_REPLAY_FAILURE: absolute residual difference exceeded the solver-scale tolerance
failure_taxonomy.ROOT_CLASSIFICATION_DEGENERATE: local Jacobian/index did not converge to X or O
failure_taxonomy.ROOT_OUTSIDE_CHANNEL: root is outside the declared plasma/channel domain
failure_taxonomy.ROOT_WALL_ONLY: root lies within the wall exclusion margin
failure_taxonomy.SEPARATRIX_UNRESOLVED: offset constant-psi probes did not establish the declared connectivity

families.source_policy: equal-strength strictly alternating stages; accepted inner/outer equivalent-current sheets remain paired

gpu_replay.comparison: absolute tolerance based CUDA reproducibility; residual reproducibility and field equality are separate gates

residual_reproducibility.absolute_final_residual_difference_limit: 0.1 times max(original stopping scale, replay stopping scale)
residual_reproducibility.stopping_scale: max(solver absolute tolerance, solver relative tolerance times initial residual)

classification.O: positive determinant, winding index approximately +1, and converged coarse/refined Jacobian
classification.X: negative determinant, winding index approximately -1, and converged coarse/refined Jacobian

local_topology.jacobian: finite differences of symmetry-extended (B_r,B_z) in physical r,z

physical_domains.axis_policy: r=0 is a coordinate singularity representing an interior physical axis and is eligible when the symmetry-extended Jacobian/index converges
physical_domains.plasma_channel: axisymmetric volume 0 <= r < chamber_outer_radius and 0 < z < chamber_length

provenance.dependency_closure: all tracked blobs under this experiment and accepted coupling, fields, geometry and magnetics package trees plus pyproject and specifications
provenance.dependency_identity: Git blob SHA-1 from the preregistration commit and accepted baseline
provenance.semantic_json_identity: SHA-256 of canonical sort-key compact UTF-8 JSON values
provenance.text_identity: SHA-256 after CRLF/CR normalization to LF

publication.allowed: field, root, local topology, separatrix connectivity, map correspondence and descriptive stage-relation characterization only

purpose: Establish the empirical physical stage-to-vector-null-to-closed-cell relation before a separately preregistered search v3.

result_lifecycle.post_run: same tests validate canonical semantic identities, complete inventory, protocol commit, dependency closure, lock and replay gates
result_lifecycle.pre_run: tests pass with no results directory

separatrix.cell_bounding_requirement: X root with at least one nearby simple closed constant-psi component wholly inside the plasma channel and a changed nearby closed-component count across the two offset levels
separatrix.closed_cell_definition: O root with a nearby simple closed constant-psi component wholly inside the plasma channel
separatrix.psi_probe_delta: max(1e-12 Wb, 0.02 times local 5x5-stencil psi span)
separatrix.saddle_tie_policy: reject at exact root; characterize connected components on both fixed offset levels
